daily.topThemeTitle: Procurement and Interoperability Still Framed as AI's Prerequisite
daily.topThemeBody: EdTech Magazine's new Five Quality Indicators purchasing framework and Ed-Fi's ongoing data-standard work continue to press governed vetting and shared data infrastructure as prerequisites for trustworthy AI adoption, not afterthoughts.
